_help: House rules, shown at the top of the Rules page above the ESPN settings. Edit any text in quotes. Anything that still starts with "Fill in" shows as a placeholder. payouts and rules are lists shown in order: add or delete entries freely (mind the commas between them). In rules, text is either one sentence in quotes or a list of them in [ ], which shows as bullet points. Delete buyIn, payouts or lastPlace to hide that part.
updated: Fill in: when these were last agreed, e.g. August 2026

buyIn.due: Fill in: when it's due and how to pay (Venmo, cash at the draft, etc.)

lastPlace.title: Last-place punishment
lastPlace.text: Fill in: what the last-place finisher has to do, and the deadline to do it.

rules.title: Draft
rules.text: Fill in: draft date and place, and how the draft order is set.

rules.title: Trades
text: Fill in: who reviews trades (commissioner, league vote, nobody).
Fill in: anything off limits, like trades with teams that are already eliminated.

rules.title: Lineups
rules.text: Fill in: rules about tanking, or leaving players on bye or injured in the lineup.

rules.title: Disputes
rules.text: Fill in: how arguments get settled.
